implementation.readinessResolution: All six evidence classes are checked once when the target evidence view is constructed. Every ref occurrence must resolve before emission eligibility is actionable.

failureStates.declaration-unbuilt: A Class B declaration file is unavailable.
failureStates.reference-unresolved: An evidence class, Class A file, or required symbol is unavailable.

implementation.profileAggregation: Component registry and target readiness issues are evaluated together, preserving OODS-V119 and OODS-N015 in the same profile response.
implementation.prototypeDefense: Object.hasOwn guards protect component contracts, prop rules, target extensions, required props, content strategies, style mappings, dependency catalogs, and framework maps.

singleExportRemoval.mutationMethod: in-memory read view; tracked package sources were never edited

portableBuiltModule.method: Relocate the built mcp-server package beneath an external non-Git temporary root with repository source and target declarations absent, then import the relocated code.generate handler.

limitations: The original planning-session prototype stdout was not retained. planning-prototype-replay.reconstructed.json is an exact archived-commit replay and is labeled reconstructed.
The fresh packed run used an external temporary artifact root; its sanitized outcome and tarball hashes are retained here, not the temporary tarballs themselves.
